content: Two community external-dns webhook providers for Mikrotik RouterOS static DNS: mirceanton/external-dns-provider-mikrotik (Helm chart, sidecar/webhook alongside external-dns, RouterOS 7.16 tested, A/AAAA/CNAME/MX/NS/SRV/TXT, REST API auth with api+rest-api+read+write policies, active v1.6.3 June 2026) and benfiola/external-dns-routeros-provider (sidecar on localhost:8888). Enables per-app LAN DNS records driven from Ingress annotations.
